name: target/search
description: Search Target products by keyword with TCIN, brand, price, sale price, rating, reviews and pickup, delivery and shipping availability.

q.description: The query you want to search. You can use anything that you would use in a regular Target search (e.g., `coffee`, `65 inch tv`, or `lego star wars`).

page.description: Value is used to get results on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Target returns up to 24 results per page, plus sponsored products, and up to 50 pages.

sort.description: The sorting of the results. It defaults to `relevance`. Available options: `relevance` - Relevance `featured` - Featured `price_low` - Price: low to high `price_high` - Price: high to low `rating_high` - Guest rating `best_seller` - Bestselling `newest` - Newest Target only shows sponsored products when results are sorted by `relevance`.

facet.description: The filters to apply, like Target's filters (e.g., deals, brands, sizes, colors, or guest ratings). It's a comma-separated list of filter IDs (e.g., `5tdv0,4yagy` for Sale and Dark Roast). Filter IDs are available in `filters[].options[].id` of the results when `include_filters` is set to `true`. Like on Target, a search without filters can be filtered automatically by Target (e.g., Brand: LEGO for `lego`), as shown in `applied_filters`. Setting `facet` replaces these filters with yours.

spelling.description: Whether to fix the spelling of misspelled queries, like Target. It can be set to `true` (default) to search for the spelling fix (e.g., `coffee` for `cofee`), as shown in `search_information.spelling_fix`, or `false` to search for the query as typed, like Target's Search instead for link.

store_id.description: The Target store to get prices and availability for, like the store selected on Target (e.g., `1375` for Mpls Nicollet Mall, MN). The store ID is the number at the end of the store's page URL on Target (e.g., `https://www.target.com/sl/mpls-nicollet-mall/1375`). It defaults to `1771` (Cedar Rapids South, IA), the store Target uses when it can't locate the visitor.

max_price.description: The maximum price of the products, in US dollars (e.g., `50`).

min_price.description: The minimum price of the products, in US dollars (e.g., `10`).

category_id.description: The category to search in (e.g., `hz89j` for Kitchen & Dining). Category IDs are available in the `Category` filter of the results when `include_filters` is set to `true`.

delivery_zip.description: The US ZIP code to deliver to (e.g., `10001`). It's used for the shipping dates and the same day delivery availability. It defaults to the location of the store.

include_filters.description: Whether to include the `filters` of the search in the JSON response, with the IDs to use in `facet` and `category_id`. It can be set to `true` or `false` (default).

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.
